name: Storyblok
description:
The Storyblok MCP Server connects Claude directly to your Storyblok workspace, giving it access to the Content Management API. Search, read, create, update and publish stories, as well as manage components, assets, releases, tags, and data sources directly from your conversation with Claude.
The server uses a discovery-first architecture (from search to describe to execute) instead of exposing one tool per API endpoint, so Claude always finds the right operation and confirms its parameters before acting, reducing the risk of unintended changes to live content. 
Whether you’re looking to update or publish stories by keyword, generate metadata or translations for existing content, or manage digital assets, the Storyblok MCP server is the right tool for you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Storyblok to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Storyblok to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.storyblok.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Storyblok MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storyblok provides these MCP tools: describe, execute_destructive, execute_mutating, execute_readonly, search, upload_asset, and upload_asset_finish.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Storyblok?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Storyblok in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Storyblok requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Storyblok is developed by Storyblok. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
